schedules.title: Morning briefing
schedules.desc: What is scheduled, what changed overnight, and what to look at first.
schedules.prompt: Give me a short morning briefing: what is scheduled today, any notifications or errors since yesterday, and what I asked you to remember recently.

schedules.title: Weekly knowledge digest
schedules.desc: The week's memories, written as a few bullets.
schedules.prompt: Run the flow "Weekly knowledge digest" and post the result.

schedules.title: Setup check
schedules.desc: Which plugins, connectors and schedules are off or failing.
schedules.prompt: Run the flow "Setup report" and tell me if anything is switched off or has failed.

schedules.title: Paused schedules reminder
schedules.desc: Tell me if a schedule has been left paused.
schedules.prompt: Run the flow "Anything paused?" and say which schedules are paused.

schedules.title: Notification triage
schedules.desc: Sort the unread notifications into what needs me and what does not.
schedules.prompt: Go through my unread notifications, group them, and tell me which ones need me.

schedules.title: Remember my day
schedules.desc: Save the day's decisions and open items as memories.
schedules.prompt: Look at today's chats and save a memory for each decision or open item.

schedules.title: Weekly review
schedules.desc: What got done, what slipped, and the three things for next week.
schedules.prompt: Write my weekly review from this week's chats and memories: done, slipped, and next week's top three.

flows.name: Research a topic
flows.description: Search the web, read the top pages, and write a short brief with its sources
lines: ask: write a short, factual brief on the topic from these pages, with the address of each source after every claim

flows.name: Compare two pages
flows.description: Read two web pages and say how they differ
lines: ask: compare this page with the first one ({{a}}): what is the same, what differs, which is more reliable?

flows.name: Is the project healthy?
flows.description: Branch, uncommitted changes and the last commits of the working folder (reads only)

flows.name: Run the tests and explain a failure
flows.description: Run the project tests; if they fail, say what broke and where to look

flows.name: What is scheduled
flows.description: Every schedule, and how many are on

flows.name: Anything paused?
flows.description: Tell me if a schedule is paused, or that all is running
lines: if in:schedules is:paused then say: {{count}} paused: {{names}} else say: every schedule is running

flows.name: Pause every schedule
flows.description: Stop everything that runs by itself, for a holiday or a freeze (test it first)

flows.name: Resume paused schedules
flows.description: Turn back on what was paused

flows.name: Connectors that are not connected
flows.description: MCP servers that are off or lost their connection
lines: if in:connectors is:disabled then say: not connected: {{names}} else say: every connector is connected

flows.name: Setup report
flows.description: Connectors and routines at a glance, written up by the model
lines: ask: write a four-line status of this setup from what was said above, and name anything that looks missing

flows.name: What routines do I have?
flows.description: Every routine, and what it is for

flows.name: Ask an agent to review
flows.description: One of your agents reviews what a step found (change the agent and the question)
lines: agent: Researcher | review these schedules and say which overlap or look unnecessary

flows.name: My agents
flows.description: The agents you have made, and what they are for

flows.name: Connected servers
flows.description: Every MCP server that is connected

flows.name: Call a tool, tell me the result
flows.description: Call one tool of a connected server and have the model sum up what it returned (change the server, the tool and its arguments)
lines: ask: sum up what this returned in two lines

flows.name: Use a tool only if it is connected
flows.description: Check the connector first; call its tool when it is there, and say so when it is not
lines: if in:connectors github is:enabled then run: Call a tool, tell me the result else say: connect GitHub on the Connectors page first

flows.name: Resume only if something is paused
flows.description: A fork: resume paused schedules when there are some, otherwise say all is well (test it first)
lines: if in:schedules is:paused then do:resume else say: nothing was paused

flows.name: Keep resuming until none are paused
flows.description: A loop back: resume, check again, and go back while something is still paused (at most 3 laps; test it first)

flows.name: Run flows one after the other
flows.description: Runs other flows by name: the setup report first, then the paused check (add those two first)

flows.name: Call a tool, then decide
flows.description: Call a tool, then fork on what you already know about it (change the tool and the word)
lines: if in:schedules weekly then say: you have notes on this too: {{names}} else say: nothing found

flows.name: Ask, then ask again
flows.description: The model writes a draft; if it found nothing to work from it goes back once and widens the search
lines: if in:schedules weekly then ask: write a short summary of these else say: nothing found
